literal_meaning: বাঘ এবং গরুর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক (relationship between a tiger and a cow)
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রতিবেশীদের সম্পর্ক বাঘে-গরুতে সম্পর্কের মতো, কখনো মিলবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: There is a tiger-cow relationship between them.
The neighbors have a relationship like that between a tiger and a cow; they'll never get along.
note: This idiom draws from rural Bengali imagery of natural predators and prey, emphasizing inherent incompatibility.
